messages:
Maya: heads-up — planning a small canary deploy for routing-v4 tonight (02:00 UTC). low risk but includes observability changes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam: I'll be on for the deploy window. which dashboards are changing?
Maya: updating the 'inference-latency' panel to include p50/p95/p99 lines + a separate kv-cache-hit-rate panel. also adding a short trace span tag for 'route_variant'.
Liam: FYI, the observability change toggles a new histogram bucket at the ingest layer. watch for metric cardinality. keep an eye on Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/inf/serving-overview
Ana: can we push alert threshold changes as part of the same PR? or do them separately?
Maya: separate PR for alerts — want human review. Proposed alerts: p95_latency > 300ms for 5m, error_rate > 0.5% for 2m (service-level), and trace-error-rate > 0.2% for 10m. Open to adjustments.
DevEx-Jen: suggest we mute the noisy per-region anomaly alert during the canary to avoid paging. I'll add a temporary silence for "region-latency-spike".
Sam: deploy plan: 02:00 UTC — push canary image -> 10% traffic for 15m -> if healthy -> 50% for 20m -> full. Rollback plan: operator triggers rollback via deploy-bot or revert the canary tag.
Liam: smoke checks to run after canary hit: run the sample workload script and check these things:
```
# smoke-check.sh
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" https://canary.redwood.api/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":20}' | jq .output
# check KV cache hit rate, tail logs for OOM / KV-errors
```
Maya: I'll run smoke-check and tail logs. tagging @Liam for traces review if we see increased tail latencies.
Ana: who owns the dashboard PR? want to review the panel layout before deploy.
DevEx-Jen: I'll shepherd the dashboard PR. will add a note about cardinality and the new route_variant tag.
Sam: quick question — do we need to bump the metric retention for the new histogram?
Maya: no retention change for now, just new buckets. keep an eye on series explosion.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled by Maya for 1779007200 (02:00 UTC). Canary: 10% for 15m.
Maya: one more — if alert flapping starts, mute the service-level alert and escalate to oncall after rollback. Trying to keep pace with the CR. :thumbsup:
Liam: ack. I'll be available 01:50-03:30 UTC. ping me in this thread if traces look weird.
Ana: sounds good. will review the alerts PR asap.
Maya: thanks — will post the PR links here when ready.
ops-bot: deploy started (canary) for routing-v4 at 1779007200.
Maya: canary healthy after 15m, p95 down to 180ms, kv-hit-rate unchanged. moving to 50%.
Sam: running smoke-check now.
Maya: smoke results: sample request returns, no errors, logs clean.
ops-bot: deploy successful — routing-v4 promoted to full at 1779008100.
Maya: closing thread. if anyone sees unexpected alerts, please reopen/ping oncall. :white_check_mark:
